target_module: systolic_pe (a leaf PE instantiated 9x inside the top module systolic_array_gemm -- a shared, deeply-reused submodule, not the top itself)
trigger_description: Each PE counts how many accumulation windows it has serviced (how many times clr_acc has pulsed while en was asserted), reusing those two already-existing signals as the count-enable condition rather than adding a brand-new always-active counter. The golden testbench exercises the design through 18 such windows across its entire run; the counter's terminal/arming value is 19 (reached on the 20th window), safely outside golden-testbench range but reachable by simply running the design longer. Once armed, the latch stays set permanently (does not self-clear).
observable_effect: From the window in which the counter reaches its terminal value onward, every PE's c_out accumulator write -- and therefore the corresponding element(s) of the top-level c_mat_out bus -- is offset by +8192 relative to the correct value. The corruption is independent of the operand data; it depends only on cumulative usage count, and persists for every subsequent operation once armed.
expected_value_if_clean: c_mat_out elements equal the exact golden matrix-multiply accumulation on every invocation, regardless of how many prior invocations occurred.
expected_value_if_infected: c_mat_out elements match the golden result for the first 19 accumulation-window invocations, then are offset by +8192 from the 20th invocation onward, with no recovery.
